arguments.file_text:
# Custom subagents in senpi (omo-ai plugin)

- senpi core has no agent registry; the subagent catalog lives in the omo-ai plugin
  (`omo-ai/plugin/extensions/omo-task.js`). There is no markdown agent loader, so
  `~/opencode/agents/*.md` files are not read by senpi.
- Custom agents come from `~/.omo/omo.jsonc` `agents.<name>`:
  `description, prompt, model, models[], reasoning|variant, tools{name:…

  keeps them out of opencode, which loads the same md files natively.
